articles.headline: Sources: Saints QB Tyler Shough playing with 2 broken bones in non-throwing hand
articles.description: Saints quarterback Tyler Shough has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, sources told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: 関係者によると、セインツのQBタイラー・ショウは投げない方の手に2本の骨折を抱えたままプレー
articles.descriptionJa: セインツのクォーターバック、タイラー・ショウが左手の骨を2本折った状態でプレーしていることが、関係者へのESPNの取材で明らかになった。
articles.body:
New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, sources told ESPN.

Shough suffered the injury Oct. 5 in the Saints' 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons on "Monday Night Football," according to sources.

The Saints have not publicly confirmed the diagnosis, but the injury has forced Shough to tape together the ring and pinky fingers on his non-throwing hand.

The injury is expected to take weeks to heal, with one source estimating that the injury would last "a couple of months," but Shough hasn't missed any playing time. Shough is determined to play through any injury, but it has impacted how he does his job.

Shough spent last week's game against the Minnesota Vikings handing off with the opposite hand he normally uses, and he is expected to continue to do the same so long as the breaks in his left hand are an issue.

He also wore a protective glove last week atop a heavily bandaged hand, and the same protection is expected to be used for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.

Shough has been a full participant in practice since suffering the injury.

New Orleans plays the Pittsburgh Steelers next week in Paris before going on its bye week, which will give Shough more time to heal.

Shough struggled last week against a Minnesota team that ranks second in the NFL in total defense and has allowed the fewest points in the league. He passed for a career-low 96 yards and threw two interceptions in a 23-13 loss that dropped the Saints to 1-4 and drew harsh reaction from team owner Gayle Benson.

In a rare public criticism of her team, Benson said Tuesday that the Saints' start is "not acceptable" and called out several members of the organization, including coach Kellen Moore and general manager Mickey Loomis.

Shough said he shared Benson's frustration but emphasized that he thinks the Saints "are going to have a really good chance to go on a run here."

Shough has completed 66.8% of his passes this season for 1,299 yards, the seventh most in the NFL. The second-year quarterback has attempted the second-most passes in the league (205) and has been sacked 13 times -- tied for eighth-most in the NFL -- in five games.

articles.headline: Chelsea's Emi Martínez has jaw surgery, will be 'back in a few weeks'
articles.description: Emi Martínez said he would be "back in a few weeks" after undergoing surgery following a head injury suffered during Chelsea's Premier League win over Everton on Saturday.
articles.headlineJa: チェルシーのエミ・マルティネスが顎の手術、復帰は「数週間以内」の見込み
articles.descriptionJa: エミ・マルティネスは、土曜日のプレミアリーグでのエヴァートン戦における頭部の負傷に伴い手術を受けたが、「数週間以内には復帰する」と語った。
articles.body:
Emi Martínez said he would be "back in a few weeks" after undergoing surgery following a head injury suffered during Chelsea's Premier League win over Everton on Saturday. 

Chelsea confirmed on Sunday that Martínez had a "successful" operation on his jaw, adding "everyone at Chelsea wishes Emi a speedy recovery and will support him throughout."

Martínez, 34, collided with Everton's Jarrad Branthwaite when rushing from his goal to attempt to punch an Everton free kick out of his penalty area in the 67th minute of Chelsea's 2-0 win at the Hill Dickinson Stadium.

Both players received treatment on the pitch, with the Everton defender recovering quickly. Martínez, however, received extended treatment from the Chelsea physios and paramedics before being stretchered from the field while receiving oxygen.

He was replaced by 21-year-old substitute goalkeeper Mike Penders in the 75th minute. Eleven minutes of injury time were added on by the officials at the end of the match following the lengthy stoppage in play.

The Argentina goalkeeper posted a photo of himself in a hospital bed late Saturday night, with the caption: "Thank you all for the messages, the operation went well. The most important thing is that we won and with a bow at 0. We'll be back in a few weeks."

Chelsea coach Xabi Alonso earlier told reporters that Martínez was conscious when leaving the stadium and was taken to hospital for "precautionary tests," adding: "For now, we need to wait."

He added: "It was a concussion, but more than that. I saw just one clip, but we'll have to wait."

Two goals from Pedro Neto ensured Chelsea took all three points from their trip to Merseyside.

"We are really pleased. Shame for Emi, but we wish you all the best. This win is for him," Neto told TNT Sports.

Everton manager David Moyes said: "I just said to TV, I've not seen the Martínez injury yet, so I hope he's fine. I really do. I couldn't even see from the dugout. It just looked as if it was a sharing ball in between a couple of people. I don't know what else happened."

Chelsea's victory put an end to Everton's unbeaten start to the campaign and saw their defense hold firm for the first time this season.

"I'm really pleased with the performance, with the win, with the clean sheet," Alonso said. "There are many positives to build on from today. We knew it was going to be a hard challenge to win in this stadium, but we did many things to deserve the win. I think we got many things right. We were very professional, very solid, and it's good to have this feeling to win this way.

"We needed to feel like we could win in this way -- being solid, being strong, looking in control and going through difficult moments.

"In the first half, there were moments where there were corners and throw-ins and you need to overcome these moments. It's very hard in the Premier League to have full control of the game but you need to make sure you don't lose your shape or your condition, and today we did that really

articles.headline: Dejan Kulusevski set to return to Tottenham squad after 526-day injury absence
articles.description: Dejan Kulusevski will return to Tottenham's matchday squad for the first time in more than 500 days for Monday's visit of Coventry.
articles.headlineJa: デヤン・クルセフスキ、526日間の怪我による離脱を経てトッテナムのメンバーに復帰へ
articles.descriptionJa: デヤン・クルセフスキは、月曜日のコヴェントリー戦において、500日以上ぶりにトッテナムの試合メンバーに復帰する。
articles.body:
Dejan Kulusevski will return to Tottenham's matchday squad for the first time in 526 days for Monday's visit of Coventry, but Sávio and Lucas Bergvall will be absent.

Spurs have spent the majority of this week in a warm weather training camp in Marbella, but Savio was absent after he reported a "muscular problem" on Tuesday and Bergvall is sidelined for "two weeks" with a knee issue.

Those absences along with Kulusevski's ever-improving fitness have opened the door for the Swedish playmaker to potentially play on Monday night after a serious knee injury has sidelined the attacker since the end of the 2024-25 season.

"Yes, Kulusevski on the bench. We had a meeting with the medical staff. They gave the OK and it's great news. I think it's one of the best news after Everton game last season because Deki he suffered too much. He deserves to feel emotion on the pitch," boss Roberto De Zerbi told a news conference.

"Unfortunately Savio on Tuesday... before we leave for Marbella, he felt a muscular problem. We lost him for some weeks unfortunately.

"And Lucas Bergvall because he had a problem at the beginning of the game in Manchester.

"The day after Manchester [United], Sunday, he came to [the] training ground to our medical staff. And I think two weeks [out]."

De Zerbi provided a positive update on right-back Pedro Porro, who could be available for the trip to Chelsea next Saturday.

However, bottom-of-the-table Spurs will be missing seven players for the clash with Coventry with Rodrigo Bentancur suspended for a fixture where the hosts will be desperate to end a six-match winless start to the new Premier League campaign.

"Coventry is a good team. They played a fantastic Championship last season," De Zerbi said.

"But we are Tottenham, keeping humility, keeping what you want, but we want to show to be good enough to win the games, especially if we deserve to win the games."

Kulusevski could be required to help Spurs get off the mark in the league after a torrid spell on the sidelines with a patella injury, which required a second procedure in March to fix the long-standing problem.

- Roberto De Zerbi: Dejan Kulusevski return can inspire Spurs

- James Maddison can be the difference maker for Tottenham - former Coventry academy coach

- Richarlison hailed for 'immaculate' attitude in Tottenham's U21 appearance

After Kulusevski missed Tottenham's Europa League triumph in 2025, the whole of last season and this summer's World Cup, De Zerbi was delighted to tell the 26-year-old on Saturday that he would be in the matchday squad against Coventry.

De Zerbi revealed: " I said to him, 'I spoke with the medical staff and they gave me the OK' and he smiled like this [wide].

"And we are happy. We are very, very happy. It's not football. I'm not speaking about football. OK, he's a special player, but we are speaking about different things. He suffered a lot and his reaction was great."

articles.body:
Whom should you start? Whom should you sit? To help you set your fantasy football lineups and avoid starting an offensive player who won't be in the lineup, we'll post fantasy-relevant updates and analysis here as NFL teams release their official inactives lists. 

Official Sunday inactives should begin coming in approximately 90 minutes before the scheduled kickoff times: around 11:30 a.m. ET for the early games and 2:30 p.m. ET for the late-afternoon games.

Refresh often for the latest information.

Don't forget to check these out: Mike Clay's Playbook | Week 6 Buzz 

Week 6 Rankings | Matchup rankings for Week 6

Biggest concerns ahead of Sunday

Players with early starts

Caleb Williams, QB, Bears (hamstring): Williams will play in Week 6. He might opt to run less initially, but Williams is still in play as a QB1. I would use him over Trevor Lawrence, Jameis Winston and Jacoby Brissett. However, I would go with either Kirk Cousins or Jordan Love over Williams.

 A.J. Brown, WR, Patriots (ankle): Brown has been activated and is expected to play on Sunday, per Adam Schefter. He brings more risk than usual, but given all the byes and injuries, he's worth getting into starting lineups. While he brings upside and likely will see safe volume, it usually takes some time for a player to return to 100% after a high ankle sprain, so temper expectations a bit. Go with the streaming options listed above over Romeo Doubs.

Zay Flowers, WR, Ravens (toe): Flowers was added to the team's injury report Thursday but is not on the final report, meaning he will play in Week 6. His production took a hit without Jackson last week, but Flowers still saw nine targets in that game from QB Tyler Huntley, who will be under center again this week. Volume should keep him in play as a WR2. It's also worth noting that Rashod Bateman missed practice this week due to a shoulder injury but is also not on the final injury report, so he will play too. Rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane is practicing in full and Jeremy Fowler reports he is "good to go" for Week 6. He is worth stashing if you have a bench spot available.

Michael Penix Jr, QB, Falcons (ribs): Penix has been a full participant at practice all week long. He has been removed from the injury report and will start Sunday. Penix has yet to throw multiple TD passes or score 15 fantasy points in any game this season. He is purely for use in superflex formats, but his availability is great for Bijan Robinson and Drake London. Both are elite options with Penix under center.

Quinshon Judkins, RB, Browns (ankle): Judkins missed practice to start the week before getting in a limited session Friday. He is questionable and his status truly seems to be up in the air for Week 6. If he sits, the Browns will be left with Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime on the active roster. articles.description: Arsenal forward Viktor Gyökeres could leave the club in January, while Manchester United are looking to bolster their squad in January. Transfer Talk has the latest.
articles.headlineJa: 移籍の噂・ニュース：ヴィクトル・ギョケレスは1月にアーセナルを去るのか？
articles.descriptionJa: アーセナルのFWヴィクトル・ギョケレスが1月にチームを離れる可能性がある一方、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドは1月の戦力補強を模索しています。最新情報は「トランスファー・トーク」でお届けします。
articles.body:
Arsenal forward Viktor Gyökeres could leave the club in January, while Manchester United are looking to bolster their squad in January after criticism over their level of investment from defender Lisandro Martínez.

Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Viktor Gyökeres is prepared to leave Arsenal in January for more consistent game time, claims TEAMtalk. The report states that frustration over a lack of minutes has forced the Sweden international to consider his future with the Gunners, just over a year on from his initial £55 million move from Sporting CP. The 28-year-old has been restricted to three Premier League appearances so far this season, all from the bench, despite scoring 21 goals for Arsenal across all competitions last campaign. Atletico Madrid have been labelled as an interested party, while teams in Italy, Germany, and Spain have also been outlined as possible destinations.

- Liverpool are showing keen interest in Juventus defender Pierre Kalulu as an option for the January transfer window, according to Football Insider. The 26-year-old is being tracked by the Merseyside outfit as an option to bolster the backline, with his ability to play as both a centre-back and a right back viewed as highly desirable. Kalulu has a deal until 2029 with Juventus, and has featured in every game this season, suggesting any transfer could be difficult to secure.

- Manchester United are ready to dip into the January transfer market to bolster the backline amid concerns over the quality in the defensive ranks. Sky Sports reports that the club is looking at center backs and left backs who could make an impact, after spending the two previous summers improving the forward line and the midfield. It's unclear exactly what funds could be available to the recruitment team, amid growing pressure to improve after a difficult start to the season.

- Arsenal and Chelsea are both tracking the progress of Oliver Mansson, 17, during a breakthrough campaign for IFK Goteborg. That's according to TEAMtalk, who claim the midfielder has caught the eye of the two Premier League clubs, along with a whole host of other English clubs. Mansson has featured 17 times across all competitions this season, 13 of which have been in the Allsvenskan. The youngster has a deal until 2028 with Goteborg, which could prompt a move in the future, though he cannot officially move to the Premier League until next August, when he would turn 18.

- AC Milan are monitoring defensive options for the January transfer window, with Matteo Gabbia set to miss at least three months of action with a torn hamstring. Calciomercato reports contact has already been made with Gonçalo Inácio, 25, as an option, though Sporting CP will demand over €40 million for an exit. articles.headline: Knicks waive Bruce Brown, keep James Wiseman ahead of opener
articles.description: The Knicks are waiving Bruce Brown and keeping James Wiseman on the roster as the team heads into its regular-season opener, sources told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: ニックス、ブルース・ブラウンを放出、ジェームズ・ウィズマンは開幕に向けて残留
articles.descriptionJa: ESPNが報じたところによると、ニックスはレギュラーシーズン開幕を控え、ブルース・ブラウンを放出する一方で、ジェームズ・ウィズマンをロスターに留めることを決定した。
articles.body:
The New York Knicks waived Bruce Brown and will keep James Wiseman on the roster as the team heads into its regular-season opener.

Brown was one of several players on non-guaranteed deals vying for one of New York's final two available roster spots. Tony Bradley, Ochai Agbaji and Drew Eubanks were all also waived in recent days.

Wiseman appeared in all four of the Knicks' preseason games and impressed in 24 minutes vs. the Toronto Raptors on Tuesday, when he scored 18 points and grabbed 10 rebounds.

 

According to ESPN's Bobby Marks, the Knicks could have kept Brown and Wiseman, but because they are only $3.2 million below their self-imposed hard cap at the second apron, retaining both players would've been difficult.  

Wiseman, 25, will join Karl-Anthony Towns and Andre Drummond in New York's center rotation. The reigning NBA champions lost key reserve big man Mitchell Robinson to the Boston Celtics this past summer via free agency.

The Knicks begin the NBA's regular season Tuesday, when they host the new-look Philadelphia 76ers.

articles.headline: USMNT's Reyna continues resurgence with goal in Strasbourg loss to PSG
articles.description: United States midfielder Gio Reyna continued his recent impressive form, scoring for Strasbourg against Paris Saint-Germain in the French league on Saturday.
articles.headlineJa: 米国代表レイナ、PSG戦で得点し復活の好調を維持
articles.descriptionJa: 米国代表MFジオ・レイナが、土曜日のフランスリーグでのパリ・サンジェルマン戦でストラスブールの得点者となり、最近の素晴らしいフォームを維持した。
articles.body:
United States midfielder Gio Reyna continued his recent impressive form, scoring for Strasbourg against Paris Saint-Germain in the French league on Saturday.

Reyna broke the deadlock in the 17th minute with a low shot that took a slight deflection past Matvei Safonov in the PSG goal.

- USMNT players are beefing online again: A look at the most memorable, pettiest feuds

- U.S. prodigy Sullivan sets latest MLS record, says performance was 'terrible'

- Sources: FIFA set to change rules that led to Balogun World Cup red card reversal

It was enough for the home team to lead at halftime, but PSG replied with three goals after the break to win 3-1.

The 23-year-old Reyna was making his seventh league appearance for Strasbourg after joining the team from German side Borussia Mönchengladbach in the offseason. He scored in a 6-2 win at Troyes last month.

Reyna, who has struggled with fitness in recent seasons, started all four games -- contributing two assists -- for the U.S. men's national team in the recent international break.

Strasbourg has now lost its last three games to fall down to 12th in the Ligue 1 standings, but Reyna said the team can take plenty of positives from Saturday's performance.

"In my opinion, if we played many other teams in the league like we played tonight we come away with three points and we're very happy right now," he told reporters. "But in the end PSG came here and took their chances and was very, very dangerous.

"We just have to keep going and put the last two games that maybe weren't as good behind us and use this mentality and the way we played today as the standard of what we should do every week. If we do this, I'm sure we're gonna win many games this season."

PSG coach Luis Enrique evidently had Tuesday's Champions League clash with Barcelona in mind as he started with Ousmane Dembélé, Désiré Doué, Vitinha, Nuno Mendes and Achraf Hakimi all on the bench.

They were on the field by the time Dembélé fired a penalty wide in the 72nd after Pape Demba Diop was penalized for hand ball.

But Ukraine defender Illya Zabarnyi finally equalized five minutes later, Dembélé popped up with what seemed the winner in the 85th, and Doué made sure in stoppage time.

"I thought we did really well to work as a team to keep them quiet for the first 70 minutes," Reyna added. "Then, obviously, if you bring guys like this onto the pitch it's not easy, you see what they've done the last two seasons, they're the best team in the world.

"Of course there's things we can still do better and expect out of ourselves to stop these actions but you have to give respect when respect is due and we gave everything tonight so a lot to be proud of."

The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Mikel Arteta: 'Big believer' Arsenal's Kai Havertz can score 30 goals a season
articles.description: Mikel Arteta has said he is a "big believer" that Kai Havertz can be Arsenal's 30-goal-a-season man.
articles.headlineJa: ミケル・アルテタ監督「カイ・ハフェルツはシーズン30得点できると確信している」
articles.descriptionJa: ミケル・アルテタ監督は、カイ・ハフェルツがアーセナルのシーズン30得点得点手になれることを「強く信じている」と語った。
articles.body:
Mikel Arteta has said he is a "big believer" that Kai Havertz can be Arsenal's 30-goal-a-season man.

Havertz is set to lead the line for Arsenal in their clash at Nottingham Forest on Sunday as he continues to be preferred to the out-of-favour Viktor Gyökeres.

The German joined Arsenal from Chelsea in 2023, scoring 14 goals in his first season at the Emirates Stadium before netting 15 in the following campaign.

A hamstring injury saw him miss the concluding four months of that season before both hamstring and knee problems restricted him to just 24 appearances across all competitions last term, with a return of seven goals.

The 27-year-old has started all of Arsenal's league games so far, scoring twice in the Premier League champions' opening three games, but has not found the back of the net since -- a barren streak of five matches.

However, speaking ahead of Sunday's contest at the City Ground, Arteta insisted Havertz can hit as many as 30 goals a season.

"He has that ability," Arteta said. "That is why he is playing there as well, and that is why we signed him.

"He needs that volume of games and actions, and if you give him that, I am a big believer that yes, he can do it.

"His football IQ is something else. He understands everything at such speed, and he can break down information better probably than anyone else on the team.

- Mikel Arteta defends Viktor Gyökeres after goalless start to season

- Mikel Merino: I am 'fortunate to be alive' after Dortmund bus attack

- Eberechi Eze to perform Cristiano Ronaldo-inspired celebration after loss to IShowSpeed

"That's something that's not easy to say especially when we talk about a striker. He was out for a long period of time last season and to get back at the highest level is not easy and it can take time.

"But Kai has done it almost immediately from pre-season and I'm not surprised because his mentality is top. I value him a lot."

Gyökeres was handed just his third start of the season in Arsenal's Champions League match against Lille on Tuesday night.

The Sweden international was withdrawn midway through the second half having made little impact on the game.

Gyökeres scored 97 times across 102 appearances for former club Sporting Lisbon, but he is yet to find the back of net in his seven games this season.

"That's a very personal question," Arteta said, when asked if Gyökeres, who struck 21 times in his debut campaign for the Gunners, is low on confidence.

"What he transmits to me is an incredible will and determination and work-rate to improve and help the team.

"That's Viktor every single day, regardless of his position, whether he scores a goal or not, and that's why he's always an option to play.

"We are trying to help him as much as possible. He has some very good moments, but it's very small margins, and scoring, or not scoring, changes the narrative."

articles.headline: Harry Kane breaks another record in 100th Bundesliga appearance for Bayern Munich
articles.description: Harry Kane scored his 102nd goal in his 100th Bundesliga game on Saturday, the most by any player in the league's history after a century of appearances.
articles.headlineJa: ハリー・ケイン、バイエルンでのブンデスリーガ100試合出場で新たな記録を更新
articles.descriptionJa: 土曜日のブンデスリーガ100試合目でハリー・ケインが102点目を記録。これはリーグ史上、100試合出場時点での最多得点記録となった。
articles.body:
Harry Kane scored his 102nd goal in his 100th Bundesliga game on Saturday, the most by any player in the league's history after a century of appearances.

During Bayern Munich's 6-1 victory over RB Leipzig, Kane tapped home from Nathaniel Brown's cutback in the 53rd minute to make it 5-0 and mark the milestone with a goal.

In doing so, Kane ensured he smashed the existing record of 72 after 100 appearances -- set by Timo Konietzka for Borussia Dortmund in the 1960s -- by a whopping 30 goals.

It was Kane's fourth goal in six Bundesliga games so far this season, with the England captain having also bagged three in two in the Champions League, as well as a brace in the German Cup win over VfL Osnabruck.

Saturday's achievement is the latest in a long line of records that Kane has broken since arriving from Spurs in 2023.

In September, during a 4-0 victory over Union Berlin, he became the fastest player to reach 100 goals, in his 98th appearance for Bayern.

In total across all competitions, he has scored 155 goals in 157 games for the German club, winning two Bundesliga titles as well as the 2026 German Cup.

The 33-year-old is close to signing a new deal at the club which would keep him there until 2029, sources told ESPN on Friday. His current deal is due to expire at the end of this season.

- Harry Kane has talent for NFL - Jags kicker Cam Little

- Harry Kane close to new Bayern Munich contract - sources

- Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool's Wirtz to Bayern Munich?

Kane is the favourite to win the Ballon d'Or for the first time, with the ceremony set to take place on Oct. 26.

Should he play against Croatia in England's Nations League game on Nov. 12, Kane will also become his nation's most-capped player of all time, with 126 appearances, surpassing the record set by Peter Shilton in 1990.

He is already England's top scorer, with 91 goals.

Information from ESPN Global Research contributed to this report.

articles.headline: 76ers, needing frontcourt help, convert 7-foot-6 Tacko Fall to two-way contract
articles.description: The 76ers, dealing with injuries in the frontcourt, have converted center Tacko Fall to a two-way contract.
articles.headlineJa: フロントコートの補強を必要とする76ers、7フィート6インチのタコ・フォールとツーウェイ契約を締結
articles.descriptionJa: フロントコートでの怪我に悩まされている76ersは、センターのタコ・フォールをツーウェイ契約に切り替えた。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- The 76ers have converted center Tacko Fall to a two-way contract, the team announced Saturday.

Last month, the Sixers signed the 7-foot-6 center to an Exhibit 10 deal, and injuries to the frontcourt likely led to Fall getting this spot.

Ariel Hukporti, projected to be the Sixers' backup center, suffered a season-ending right Achilles tear in the preseason. Center Adem Bona, potentially the next man up, has been sidelined with a foot injury, and Dominick Barlow has battled back soreness that kept him out of the preseason.

Fall hasn't played in the NBA since the 2021-22 season, when he was with the Cleveland Cavaliers. This will be his fourth season in the NBA. He played his first two in Boston with new Sixers forward Jaylen Brown.

Fall, 30, most recently played for the Ningbo Rockets of the Chinese Basketball Association.

articles.headline: James, Embiid play 76ers' preseason finale, 'still working on our rhythm'
articles.description: Without VJ Edgecombe, who was held out of Friday night's 125-120 loss to the Celtics, 76ers coach Nick Nurse gave the closest glimpse of what his team may look like this season, including LeBron James and Joel Embiid playing preseason highs in minutes.
articles.headlineJa: ジェームズとエンビード、76ersのプレシーズン最終戦に出場、「まだリズムを掴もうとしているところ」
articles.descriptionJa: 金曜夜のセルティックス戦（120-125で敗戦）を欠場したVJ・エッジコムが不在の中、76ersのニック・ナース監督は、レブロン・ジェームズとジョエル・エンビードがプレシーズン最多の出場時間を記録するなど、今シーズンのチーム像を最も具体的に示す形となった。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- As the 76ers begin a season with a star-laden roster, center Joel Embiid rejects the narrative that anyone needs to sacrifice for this team to succeed.

"I'm against the concept of sacrificing," Embiid said after Friday's preseason finale. "I think the way I explained it was you do what you do best, and we're going to support you. ... I don't think anybody has to take a back seat."

Albeit without second-year starting guard VJ Edgecombe, who was held out of Friday's 125-120 loss to the Boston Celtics for precautionary reasons, Sixers coach Nick Nurse gave the closest glimpse of what his team may look like this season.

The other active Sixers starters -- LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown and Embiid -- all played preseason highs in minutes and well into the second half. Embiid, who struggled in his last appearance two games ago against the Brooklyn Nets, finishing with six points and eight turnovers, was dominant.​

He scored 27 points, grabbed eight rebounds and added five assists. In the third quarter, he had one of the game's highlights when he threw down an emphatic dunk that drew roars from fans at Xfinity Mobile Arena.

"It's good to dunk. I thought I would never dunk again," Embiid said with a smile. "I guess I don't know what happened. I kind of got possessed."

Still, the group never looked comfortable together on the floor, despite playing against Celtics reserves. After the game, players didn't shy away from their somewhat disjointed performance. Brown pointed to the team's spacing Friday night, which he said led to turnovers, as one of the many things they need to fix moving forward.

"We're not where we want to be yet," he said. "So that's just a part of it. It's a part of coming together, a new group with a bunch of guys, different style, but we just got to keep getting better every day."

James echoed Brown's comments, but neither seemed concerned about the Sixers' ability to eventually jell.

"We're getting there," James said. "I mean, obviously we are a couple of weeks in, so we're still working on our rhythm, working on our kinks, and it's not going to be perfect."

The Sixers open the regular season against the New York Knicks on Tuesday.

articles.headline: No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa injures ankle during Wizards' preseason finale
articles.description: First overall pick AJ Dybantsa exited the Wizards' preseason finale after injuring his ankle on an awkward landing and will undergo further evaluation.
articles.headlineJa: ドラフト1位指名のAJ・ディバンツァ、ウィザーズのプレシーズン最終戦で足首を負傷
articles.descriptionJa: 全体1位指名のAJ・ディバンツァが、ウィザーズのプレシーズン最終戦で不自然な着地により足首を負傷して途中交代した。今後、詳細な検査を受ける予定。
articles.body:
First overall pick AJ Dybantsa exited the Washington Wizards' preseason finale Friday after injuring his ankle on an awkward landing and will undergo further evaluation.

Wizards coach Brian Keefe told sideline reporter Chase Hughes that Dybantsa had suffered a mild ankle sprain but that the decision to keep him out for the rest of the game was more precautionary.

"We'll look at it more when we get more information," Keefe said.

Dybantsa fell to the ground after landing on his left ankle following a midrange jump shot before limping to the locker room. He had scored 12 points in 15 minutes before his exit in the second quarter.

The Wizards open the regular season Wednesday against the Milwaukee Bucks.
